OUTPUT.description: Folder that transcript writes run-record.json and transcript.jsonl to.

OSF_DATA.description: Folder where run records every session as sessions/<session ID>.jsonl.

OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.description: Resource attributes of the run as key=value pairs, set by the launcher, for example osf.run.id=…,osf.work_item.id=…,osf.factory.version=…. run keeps them with each session; transcript writes them into the run record.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: The service.name of the run record. Default: harness-acp.
